name: Sandbag Move

movements.notes: down the stadium stairs, across the floor, up a wall, and up the far stairs

origin.summary: An event from the 2010 CrossFit Games. The CrossFit Games are the season's final championship stage, where the qualified field competes across multiple events to crown the Fittest on Earth. Games events are tests first and workouts second — many use loads, formats, or venues no affiliate would program, which is exactly why they make interesting benchmarks.

description: Carrying a heavy sandbag down the stadium stairs, across the floor, up a wall, and up the far stairs — a single-movement venue-specific carry.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/games/2010/4 (official CrossFit Games event, individual division), retrieved 2026-07-10
